title: 1289. Java Program: 2D Matrix Addition
description:

Java Program: 2D Matrix Addition
10
Easy
Problem Statement:
Write a Java program to add two 2D matrices of integers. 
Input Description:
The program should accept: 
An integer r representing the number of rows in the matrices. 
An integer c representing the number of columns in the matrices. 
r × c integers representing the elements of the first matrix. 
r × c integers representing the elements of the second matrix. 
Output Description:
The program should print the resulting sum matrix, where each element is the sum of the corresponding elements from the two matrices. 
Each row of the resulting matrix should be printed on a new line. 
Sample Input:
2 2
1 2
3 4
5 6
7 8 
Sample Output:
6 8
10 12
